name: Kaza
description: Kaza is a cheerful human wizard of Zendikar, a thrill seeker who specializes in explosions and rides a levitating staff, a member of Akiri's party.

timeline.summary: Zareth apologizes for leaving Sea Gate and Akiri forgives him, welcoming him home.
timeline.quote: I'm happy to have you back.

citation.text: "Red Route" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri pitches Akiri's party on retrieving the Lithoform Core from a Murasa Skyclave, claiming it will heal Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The object I seek will heal Zendikar of all its scars.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: During the game Zareth picks Nahiri's pocket for the key; she turns the cards to granite and demands it back.
timeline.quote: Then she snapped her fingers and turned all the cards to granite.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The party and Nahiri arrive at Sunder Bay on Murasa below the Skyclave.
timeline.quote: When they finally arrived at Sunder Bay on Murasa

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and her party climb stairs she stonecrafts toward the Murasa Skyclave, Nahiri eager to erase the Roil with the Core.
timeline.quote: With the Lithoform Core, she would erase the Roil and make Zendikar as beautiful and tranquil as it was millennia ago.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri uses the key to light a stone path through the Skyclave, and the party follows it past traps.
timeline.quote: Then the glowing stones stretched out in a single line deep into the ruins.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri takes the Core and the chamber and Skyclave begin to collapse as the Roil strikes.
timeline.quote: the surrounding chamber was disintegrating, falling, tearing itself apart

citation.work: Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Orah and Kaza fall, but Kaza catches them on her staff.
timeline.quote: Kaza appeared, hovering on her magic staff, with Orah clinging to her waist.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri leads Akiri, Zareth San, Orah and Kaza up to the skyclave seeking the lithoform core.

citation.text: "Murasa Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akiri's party searches for Nahiri following Tazri's vision, and Akiri spots the changed Nahiri on an isolated fragment.
timeline.quote: She has changed, but even from a distance, Akiri knows who it is.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party enters the Skyclave through a small uncorrupted entrance, resolved to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We did not defeat the Eldrazi to be destroyed by this,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
timeline.quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
timeline.quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They barricade the door and find the carcasses of the Skyclave's creatures.
timeline.quote: Around them are the carcasses of every living creature that didn't survive the Phyrexian transformation.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
timeline.quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is lost.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Akiri leads her friends out of the collapsing Skyclave, leaping into the sky and catching a hedron with her rope.
timeline.quote: But Akiri is a master line-slinger and midway through their failing arc, she lets her rope fly.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Tazri leads the defense of Sea Gate and sends Akiri, Linvala, Kaza and Orah to investigate her vision of Nahiri's return.
timeline.quote: She received a halo-blessed vision of the return of Nahiri
